notes: This registry declares the required player-facing state contract. It does not claim that the current UI renders or tests every state.

definitions.playerMeaning: The production line has a method, device, inputs, output space and sufficient infrastructure to operate at its current actual rate.
requiredExplanation: Show the factors determining the actual rate.

definitions.playerMeaning: The line cannot start its next cycle because a required physical input is unavailable.
requiredExplanation: Show required, available, reserved and incoming quantities.
Show the first upstream supply cause.

definitions.playerMeaning: The line or extraction network cannot place its output into the owning location's storage.
requiredExplanation: Show used and total capacity for the matching storage class.

definitions.playerMeaning: Available power is reducing the production line's achievable throughput.
requiredExplanation: Show the line's location and its contribution to the power shortfall.

definitions.playerMeaning: Available cooling is reducing the production line's achievable throughput.
requiredExplanation: Show the line's location and its contribution to the cooling shortfall.

definitions.playerMeaning: Local or inter-location cargo throughput is reducing the production line's achievable throughput.
requiredExplanation: Identify the constrained hub or route and the affected cargo.

definitions.playerMeaning: The player or an authorized policy has stopped this line intentionally.
requiredExplanation: Distinguish a manual pause from an automation action.

domainSource.selector: active facility build or expansion targets this production facility

definitions.playerMeaning: The factory or production capacity exists as an active construction commitment but is not operational yet.
requiredExplanation: Link the planned facility to its authoritative construction project.

domainSource.selector: facility, production device or method is not operational

definitions.playerMeaning: A built line cannot operate because its facility, device or selected method is unavailable or incompatible.
requiredExplanation: Name the failed capability or environment condition.

domainSource.selector: runtime.status == BLOCKED and blocker is INPUT_SHORTAGE, INPUT_IN_TRANSIT or MISSING_CAPITAL_GOOD

definitions.playerMeaning: The project is committed but cannot perform its next work cycle until physical materials arrive.
requiredVisualFeedback: material plan, consumed, reserved and incoming quantities
requiredExplanation: Name the first missing material and its upstream cause.

definitions.playerMeaning: Materials may be available, but queue position, structural capacity or construction throughput prevents work.
requiredExplanation: Identify the exact capacity kind and competing projects.

definitions.playerMeaning: The project is consuming committed materials and construction throughput.
requiredExplanation: Show how current throughput determines progress.

definitions.playerMeaning: The project retains its domain commitments but performs no construction work.
requiredExplanation: Explain that consumed materials remain consumed and reservations remain governed by the domain.

definitions.playerMeaning: The project finished and its capacity or asset effect has been applied.
requiredExplanation: Show which facility, capacity or phase changed.

definitions.playerMeaning: The project was cancelled and the domain cancellation transaction determined every returned or lost asset.
requiredVisualFeedback: returned, retained and lost material summary
requiredExplanation: Explain the authoritative cancellation result without UI-side refund arithmetic.

domainSource.selector: project is revealed, incomplete and all start requirements are met

definitions.playerMeaning: The program can be committed through a normal research command.
requiredExplanation: Show industrial, facility and knowledge requirements before commitment.

domainSource.selector: project is known but start requirements are unmet

definitions.playerMeaning: The player can see the program but cannot commit it yet.
requiredExplanation: Name every start prerequisite using domain query results.

definitions.playerMeaning: The committed program is consuming research capacity and milestone inputs.
requiredExplanation: Show the active stage, route, capacity and industrial inputs.

domainSource.selector: research.status == BLOCKED and blocker is INPUT_SHORTAGE, INPUT_IN_TRANSIT or MISSING_CAPITAL_GOOD

definitions.playerMeaning: The active milestone cannot continue until a real industrial input is supplied.
requiredVisualFeedback: missing item, consumed and incoming quantities
requiredExplanation: Name the industrial producer and first upstream cause.

definitions.playerMeaning: The milestone requires a facility or installed process capability that is not operational.
requiredExplanation: Name the exact facility/module and owning location.

domainSource.selector: research stage requirement is an incomplete prototype fabrication activity

definitions.playerMeaning: The program is waiting for a physical prototype made by the industrial chain.
requiredExplanation: Show the real fabrication method and its missing inputs.

definitions.playerMeaning: The program requires a real ship, route, survey or facility validation rather than more elapsed time.
requiredExplanation: Name the exact field test and why current assets do not satisfy it.

definitions.playerMeaning: The committed program is paused and retains its authoritative progress and material history.
requiredVisualFeedback: retained milestone progress and consumed materials
requiredExplanation: Explain that pausing does not cancel committed work.

definitions.playerMeaning: The program completed every milestone and applied its technology, spillover or ship-plan effects.
requiredExplanation: Show the capabilities and content unlocked by completion.

definitions.playerMeaning: The route service has a compatible mode and usable transport capacity.
requiredVisualFeedback: actual flow, capacity, utilization and travel time
requiredExplanation: Show the assigned transport source and supported freight classes.

domainSource.selector: service is active and utilization is below the configured healthy band

definitions.playerMeaning: The route has unused capacity; this is informative unless upstream or downstream demand is blocked.
requiredExplanation: Distinguish low demand from blocked source/destination flow.

domainSource.selector: utilization is at capacity and unmet demand remains

definitions.playerMeaning: The route or handling hub is using all available throughput while cargo demand remains unmet.
requiredVisualFeedback: capacity, attempted flow and unmet demand
requiredExplanation: Identify the exact constrained route segment or handling hub.

domainSource.selector: demand blocker is NO_SUPPLY_SOURCE or LOGISTICS_OPERATING_COST

definitions.playerMeaning: No eligible source can release cargo or pay the route's operating costs.
requiredExplanation: Name the missing source stock, reserve, propellant, maintenance material or energy.

definitions.playerMeaning: Cargo remains in transit ownership because the destination cannot accept it.
requiredExplanation: Show why unloading failed without treating cargo as lost.

domainSource.selector: no compatible mode, service capacity or eligible assigned ship exists

definitions.playerMeaning: A path may exist, but no valid transport service can move this freight.
requiredExplanation: Name the unavailable mode, ship capability, facility or technology.
requiredPossibleAction: build or configure a compatible ship

definitions.playerMeaning: The route service is intentionally disabled and dispatches no new cargo.
requiredExplanation: Distinguish intentional pause from missing transport.

definitions.playerMeaning: Only the celestial location identity is known; industrial environment and resource data remain hidden.
requiredExplanation: Explain what detection will reveal and what vessel/cost it requires.

definitions.playerMeaning: Broad environment and resource categories are known, but exact grade, potential and byproducts remain hidden.
requiredExplanation: Identify which values remain uncertain until Surveyed.
requiredPossibleAction: Assign an eligible survey vessel for investment-grade survey

definitions.playerMeaning: The location has investment-grade environment, grade range, extraction potential and method information.
requiredExplanation: Show which exact details still require Deep Survey.
requiredPossibleAction: assign a vessel for Deep Survey

definitions.playerMeaning: Exact resource grade, advanced potential and known byproducts are available for high-risk investment and megastructure siting.
requiredVisualFeedback: exact grade, advanced potential and byproducts
requiredExplanation: Show how the deep-survey data changes valid methods or site selection.

domainSource.selector: research program unavailable or not yet revealed

definitions.playerMeaning: The endgame project is visible but its engineering program is not yet available.
requiredExplanation: Name the progression condition that reveals the engineering program.
requiredPossibleAction: Open the relevant progression or research prerequisite

definitions.playerMeaning: The megastructure is known, but its multi-stage engineering program must be completed before site commitment.
requiredExplanation: Show the exact research milestone currently preventing site commitment.

domainSource.selector: research complete and no valid deep-surveyed site is committed

definitions.playerMeaning: Engineering is complete, but the player must deeply survey and commit one legal construction site.
requiredExplanation: Show each candidate's legal survey and site requirements.

domainSource.selector: active phase is blocked by material or in-transit supply

definitions.playerMeaning: The current physical phase cannot continue until its real materials and capital goods reach the worksite.
requiredVisualFeedback: delivered, reserved, missing and incoming quantities
requiredExplanation: Trace the top missing input through producer and route to the worksite.

domainSource.selector: project.status == BUILDING and current phase is a construction phase

definitions.playerMeaning: The current megastructure phase is consuming materials, power and construction throughput at the selected site.
requiredExplanation: Show the active phase and current limiting throughput.
requiredPossibleAction: pause or cancel under domain rules

definitions.playerMeaning: The structure exists at system scale and is being connected to the industrial and energy network.
requiredVisualFeedback: power, cooling, logistics and construction requirements
requiredExplanation: Show the exact integration capacity shortfall, if any.

definitions.playerMeaning: The completed physical systems are undergoing final power, cooling, logistics and maintenance validation.
requiredVisualFeedback: all commissioning requirements and top blocker
requiredExplanation: Show current versus required commissioning values, including maintenance coverage.

definitions.playerMeaning: All eight physical phases and final commissioning are complete.
requiredVisualFeedback: phase history and total industrial contribution
requiredExplanation: Summarize materials, capital goods, cargo, construction throughput and completion time.
requiredPossibleAction: Inspect the completed project ledger and system outcome
